summary: Clean on the MEM dimension. _c.py is a set of thin @proxy scalar-FFI wrappers (every signature uses intp/int32 args and returns) routed through _call_lib_func, which classifies them all as _CLASS_SCALAR (direct pass) -- so no struct-by-value, eightbyte, sret, or repack path is ever exercised, and there is no NRT/refcount/cfunc surface to leak. The platform-variable C-type hazard called out in the target notes (long/time_t -> register corruption on Windows LLP64) does not apply: those functions (fseek/time/strtol) are deliberately absent from this module; the only platform-variable types present are size_t (modeled as intp -- pointer-width, correct on every supported 64-bit ABI) and int (int32, correct everywhere). Library lifetime is handled correctly: load_lib("c") caches and pins the CDLL handle for process lifetime, preventing the dlclose-after-return UAF of JIT-resolved extern symbols.
